scope: Manual topology and exact literal fragment conservation only. No tests, native simulation, raw capture reduction or all-state formal proof performed by this reviewer.
reasoning: 79-bit context includes sticky local error, all eight state flags, 13-bit size, 13-bit count, 12-bit sequence and 32-bit raw prefix.
Every owner applies release then ordered descriptor writes before the four body contexts gather.
Each body lane forwards all earlier active same-full-ID contexts in order; latest match wins and includes sticky error. Invalid SOP resets raw/count as before but does not clear a prior error.
Scatter selects only the last active body writer for each full six-bit ID. Earlier context state and errors have already been forwarded.
Zero-keep body metadata remains checked by the unchanged global protocol-error reduction. Global OR of per-entry errors prevents malformed repeated-ID sequences from retiring as accepted events.
Full next-state event gather and sequential halt/flush behavior are byte-identical to frozen v4.
limitations: The manual/literal argument does not replace exhaustive HDL equivalence or native execution.
Author finite arbitrary-prestate comparisons and native runs are not claimed as independently replayed here.
